notes.title: Patch #3 Is Out Now!
notes.content:
The third Patch for Life is Strange: True Colors is now live. 

Thank you again for your patience and help reporting issues during the launch of Life is Strange: True Colors.
[b]Issues Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] HDR enabled (DX11 only)
[*] Frame rate issues around Steph Power Moment fixed
[/list]
[b]Size: 245MB[/b]
Please see our most [url=https://sqex.link/vaao]recent blog entry[/url] for more information on fixes and current investigations.

notes.title: Patch #2 Is Out Now!
notes.content:
The second Patch for Life is Strange: True Colors is now live. Thank you again for your patience and help reporting issues during the launch of Life is Strange: True Colors. 

[h3]Issues Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] A bug that caused Jed to T-Pose in the Black Lantern during Chapter 2 has been resolved
[*] A bug that caused Alex to T-Pose Chapter 2 has been resolved
[/list]
[h3]Size: 125MB[/h3]
Please see[url=https://sqex.link/myz5] our most recent blog entry[/url] for more information on current and upcoming fixes.
